name: Arthdal Chronicles
description: In a mythical land called Arth, the inhabitants of the ancient city of Arthdal and its surrounding regions vie for power as they build a new society.

videos.title: Episode 1
Episode 2
Part 1: The Children of Prophecy I
videos.overview: Sanung and the Saram propose an alliance with the blue-eyed Neanthal, but when things don’t go as expected, Tagon takes command of the Great Hunt.

videos.title: Part 1: The Children of Prophecy II
videos.overview: The villagers cast suspicion on Eunseom upon learning that he has dreams. Tanya questions her destiny. Tagon greets his men in an unlikely place.

videos.title: Part 1: The Children of Prophecy III
videos.overview: Upon finding Doti, Eunseom devises a plan to rescue the Wahan and is dismayed to learn the significance of Igutu - and what this means for him.

videos.title: Part 1: The Children of Prophecy IV
videos.overview: Eunseom and Doti run into a familiar face in Arthdal and make an alarming discovery. Sanung grows suspicious of his son. Tanya stands up for her tribe.

videos.title: Part 1: The Children of Prophecy V
videos.overview: As Tagon’s declaration ripples through Arthdal, Eunseom contemplates the significance of what he saw. Mubaek seeks advice and is given a quest.

videos.title: Part 1: The Children of Prophecy VI
videos.overview: Taealha counsels Tagon about the impending meeting with Eunseom. Mihol tries to persuade Asa Ron to expose the truth. Tanya sees a mystifying vision.

videos.title: Part 2: The Sky Turning Inside Out, Rising Land I
videos.overview: After a chance encounter, Tanya starts to grasp the meaning of the dream. Tagon’s plan upsets Taealha. Mubaek learns something astounding about Eunseom.

videos.title: Part 2: The Sky Turning Inside Out, Rising Land II
videos.overview: Saya has chilling words for Taealha. Tagon strengthens his grip over Arthdal. Tanya receives news of Eunseom and wonders what Saya’s dreams might mean.

videos.title: Part 2: The Sky Turning Inside Out, Rising Land III
videos.overview: Tanya proposes an alliance with Saya that proves to be useful for them both, Eunseom refuses to deny who he is, and ominous signs appear in Arthdal.

videos.title: Part 2: The Sky Turning Inside Out, Rising Land IV
videos.overview: Tagon visits Tanya and asks about the Wahan. After hearing about Tanya's dreams, Saya decides to tell her his story. Mubaek comes across something odd.

videos.title: Part 2: The Sky Turning Inside Out, Rising Land V
videos.overview: Harim makes a startling confession to Mubaek. Chaeeun goes to see Tanya and tells her the truth about Eunseom. Mihol offers Taealha a way out.

videos.title: Part 2: The Sky Turning Inside Out, Rising Land VI
videos.overview: Tagon becomes enraged when he discovers Mihol is behind Tanya’s abduction, and the two later meet to discuss her fate. Eunseom orchestrates an escape.

videos.title: Part 3: Arth, the Prelude to All Legends I
videos.overview: Tanya becomes overwhelmed by Arthdal’s reception of her new role, and demands that Taealha and Tagon keep their end of the bargain.

videos.title: Part 3: Arth, the Prelude to All Legends II
videos.overview: Mihol informs Tagon about the finer points of being a king. Saya’s appearance bewilders the Wahan. Eunseom receives help from the Neanthal.

videos.title: Part 3: Arth, the Prelude to All Legends III
videos.overview: Surviving in Arthdal means knowing how to choose the side that holds power. Taealha is attacked, and Tagon silences those who’ve uncovered his secret.

videos.title: Part 3: Arth, the Prelude to All Legends IV
videos.overview: Tanya tries to uphold the ways of the Wahan but is dismayed to find that they have changed. Tagon’s guards make a gruesome discovery.

videos.title: Part 3: Arth, the Prelude to All Legends V
videos.overview: Eunseom wrestles with a proposition and ponders how he’ll find Tanya. Saya plots a strategy for Tagon to be king. Mihol gives Taealha a stern warning.

videos.title: Part 3: Arth, the Prelude to All Legends VI
videos.overview: Tanya receives word of the Wahan and meets someone who’s seen Eunseom. Saya grows increasingly leery of those around him. Tagon gets what he wants.

videos.title: Weak Ones
videos.overview: Eight years has passed since Tagon took the throne as the second coming of Aramun. Eunseom succeeded in uniting the Ago clans as the second coming of Inaishingi and he leads them to the great war against Arthdal. Meanwhile, Saya must prove his worth to succeed Tagon.

videos.title: War of Twins
videos.overview: The first battle between Arthdal, led by Saya, and the united Ago forces, led by Eunseom, takes place in Hanchoa. Eunseom and the Ago forces gets overwhelmed by Arthdal's military power. Meanwhile, Tagon realizes the elevated status of Tanya as the second coming of Asa Sin and begins to feel threatened by her absolute power.

videos.title: Wahan's Lover
videos.overview: The united Ago forces faces an unforeseen situation, causing anxiety among its leadership that the alliance, which has been unified for 200 years, may fall apart. Meanwhile, Tanya is confronted with a truly incredible situation.

videos.title: Purple Blood
The Sword of Aramun
videos.overview: The last prophecy by Aramun is announced. Eunseom, Tanya, and Saya try to figure out what it means!

videos.title: Fake Inaishingi
Ikomahis
videos.overview: Eunseom finds an unexpected breakthrough in despair. Saya's plan envelops Arthdal in fear.

videos.title: The Strongest Creature in the World
videos.overview: They need to stop Tagon. A brutal night falls on Arthdal. Eunseom advances close to Arthdal.

videos.title: Remember My Face
videos.overview: The day of Tagon and Eunseom's battle comes. Tagon faces a shocking truth.

videos.title: Whirlwind Fire
videos.overview: Eunseom's Ago Union and Tagon's Arthdal have the final battle in the Arth Forest.

videos.title: Heroines
videos.overview: Tanya who wants to change Arthdal's owner and Taealha who wants to protect Arthdal fight.

videos.title: Arthdal Chronicles
videos.overview: The final battle between the Ago Union and Arthdal has come. Tagon prepares for a personal war. Tanya, Taealha, Saya, and Eunseom make one final move to protect what's most precious to them. Who will take over Arthdal?
